notes: NASDUCK-SERF K-3He comagnetometer search for ALP dark matter, mass range 1.4e-12 to 2e-10 eV (0.33-50 kHz), 95% C.L. The paper reports first reliable terrestrial bounds on the ALP-proton coupling g_aPP (right panel of Fig. 2) and improved ALP-neutron bounds g_aNN (left panel); per the pre-analysis hint, AxionProton is extracted here. Exact tabulated limits are only available in an external GitHub repository (Ref. [57]), so the data_points above are approximate values read from Fig. 2 and from text statements (bounds partially close regions 5e-6 to 2e-5 GeV^-1). The bounds are highly jagged (spikes); values represent the approximate mean exclusion line. DM density not explicitly stated in the text; Standard Halo Model (Lee-Lisanti-Safdi) assumed, typical rho ~0.4 GeV/cm^3 — this value is inferred, not quoted. A companion AxionNeutron limit (g_aNN ~1e-5 to 1e-4 GeV^-1 range) also exists in this paper.
